culture.allocation_policy: checked per-vector storage; aggregate consumed wire bytes and items

semantic_checks: NameManager v2 uses equal signed/unsigned counts then signed i16 usage words
Culture v45 and each versioned nested record require45; unversioned GovernmentSlot/TouristCount/TourismLocation have no version
GovernmentSlot serializes Policy hash before raw slot ordinal, reversing memory order
last_government_used pairs GovernmentTier hashes with Government hashes
always_full_religious_tourism remains i32 despite native m_b prefix
all signed fixed-point bits retained without conversion
redundant government-slot counts charge the one element vector once
Culture allocation policy checks each vector separately, cumulative wire/items; it is not a combined heap budget
saved_is_alive returns only saved ordered_flags[0]; no initialized-validity or configuration inference
